rule: A required component is evaluated in the camera/view where its reference-backed purpose is intended to be visible. FRONT_REQUIRED components need meaningful authoritative-front beauty pixels; OBLIQUE_REQUIRED depth returns need meaningful pixels in their named oblique QA view; STRUCTURAL_ONLY components remain validated by ownership and structural presence.

components.name: main glass
components.reason: The teal glass is the principal storefront surface.
components.referenceEvidence: Visible interior/glass field within the measured opening.

components.name: dark reveal
components.reason: The reference visibly uses a dark perimeter/shadow relationship around the glass.
components.referenceEvidence: Reference-derived WINDOW_OPENING_SHADOW art layer; measured 8–10 px reveal boundary.

components.name: left inner frame
components.reason: Front-visible left edge of the inner opening.

components.name: right inner frame
components.reason: Front-visible right edge of the inner opening.

components.name: top inner frame
components.reason: Front-visible top of the inner opening.

components.name: bottom inner frame
components.reason: Front-visible lower edge of the inner opening.

components.name: left sill return
components.reason: A shallow side return supports real sill depth but is intentionally not forced into the front silhouette.
components.referenceEvidence: Reference front shows the sill face, not a required left-return projection.

components.name: right sill return
components.reason: A shallow side return supports real sill depth but is intentionally not forced into the front silhouette.
components.referenceEvidence: Reference front shows the sill face, not a required right-return projection.
